params.name: bore
params.comment: the airway, square, wall face to wall face

params.name: ply
params.comment: the ply every part is cut from, nominal

params.name: block
params.comment: read only: the lattice's pitch, a block's side

params.name: straight
params.comment: a straight block's length along the airway; turns stay a block

params.name: pin_w
params.comment: the coupling pin's width (bore_split: 0.48 bore, at least 2 ply, at most bore - 4 mm)

params.name: pin_play
params.comment: the pin slot's clearance per side, measured for the 10 mm bore

params.name: pin_len
params.comment: how far a coupling pin stands out of its wall

params.name: pin_seat
params.comment: how much deeper a pin's slot is than the pin
